out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' The establishment has an employee health policy in place, but there were no signed employee agreements for the two employees working today.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. The PIC trained the employees and had them complete the forms during today’s inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels in the dispenser near the 3-vat sink hand sink. Additionally, the paper towel dispenser in the mens’ room was not working.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected both of these issues during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: meatballs on the hot rail were 126ºF for 3 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The PIC will discard the meatballs after 1 more hour. The PIC requested to use TPHC for this product from now on. A TPHC policy was created during the inspection and will be entered into the establishment record. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked eggs and veggie patties were 46º on the cold rail.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC discarded both items to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: There was a hose connected to the mop sink faucet which extended to the bottom of the sink creating a potential cross connection.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. The PIC cut the hose so that it hangs above the flood level rim of the mop sink to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Limited Food Manager - Issued by Health Department
violations.observation: There was no certified food manager in the food establishment at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM was contacted and arrived at the food establishment, during the inspection, with active credentials.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: The CFM was unable to provide proof of employee health policy documentation accessible at the food establishment.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided a copy of the employee health policy to the CFM for food service workers to sign and maintain at the food establishment.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided the CFM with a copy of the vomit and diarrhea clean up procedures during the inspection for compliance. SUBWAY (Inspection Date: 04/16/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink, located in the women’s restroom.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM replaced the hand soap in the women’s restroom for compliance and proper hand hygiene.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at the handwashing sink, located at the front service counter, used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM placed a hand washing sign at the hand sink during the inspection for compliance.
